notes.title: Minor Update: Simplified Chinese Added
notes.content: [p]The demo now supports Simplified Chinese, including both subtitles and interface text.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Released for Tiny Teams Festival
notes.content: [p]The Panopticon playable demo is now live as part of the Tiny Teams 2025 Festival, and we're incredibly honored to have been selected for the event! You can check out the full festival lineup [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025" buttoncolor="#c45f5f"]here[/url] and discover more great games from other small indie teams.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo includes all the core features of the full game, including multiplayer which will remain available until the full release. The only part that’s not included is story progression, which will be reserved for the full release.[/p][p][/p][p]We’d really appreciate your feedback, it means a lot at this stage. If you get a chance to try it out, let us know what you think, what feels good, and what could be improved.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for your support, and we hope you enjoy the demo![/p]
